prompts: Edit the supplied logo into a production-ready transparent PNG brand mark for an open-source project. Preserve the existing ribbon overlaps, smooth gradients, tapered ends, and star proportions. Remove the entire warm-white background, including the negative spaces between the ribbons and around the star, leaving TRUE transparent alpha. No white matte, white fringe, glow, drop shadow, paper texture, checkerboard pattern, lettering, border, or new elements. Keep the mark centered on a square canvas with balanced transparent padding and clean antialiased edges. This is a faithful background-removal and edge-cleanup edit, not a redesign. Retain the original colors and graceful silhouette.

Clean up this transparent logo without changing its design. Keep precisely the same flowing blue/cyan and teal double-helix ribbon geometry and violet four-point central spark. The current image has stray turquoise/blue pixels, jagged fragments and color fringes around its contours, especially next to the star tips and ribbon intersections. Remove every stray fragment, every fringe and every isolated pixel. Reconstruct clean smooth vector-like curves with polished antialiased edges and continuous gradient fills. Make each star tip a clean sharp point; all spaces between shapes must be fully transparent. Keep a true transparent alpha background, same square canvas and centered composition, no added text, white outline, glow, shadow, checkerboard, ornament or background. Finish quality: meticulous professional brand asset, clean on both light and dark backgrounds.

Rebuild the attached brand symbol as a pristine, simplified vector-style logo on a genuinely transparent canvas. Use the attached image as the design reference, not as pixels to cut out. Draw fresh, clean, perfectly smooth silhouettes: two interwoven broad ribbons forming an elegant vertical S / double helix, blue and cyan on the upper ribbon, teal and aqua on the lower ribbon, with a clearly separated violet four-point spark centered in the open space. Keep the reference composition and visual identity, gracefully tapered tips, and smooth subtle color gradients. SOLID clean shapes with opaque interiors and only thin antialiasing at their edges. No texture, grain, paper, particles, colored specks, sketch marks, white fringes, outlines, halos, shadows, checkerboard or text. All space outside the ribbons and star must be fully transparent. Professional open-source technology project icon, precision curves, crisp at small sizes, centered square canvas, approximately 10 percent top and bottom padding.
